versions.changelog:
- Initial release of AI Prompt Arsenal.
- Provides a curated toolkit of production-ready prompts and frameworks for Claude, GPT-4, Midjourney, Suno, and more.
- Supports use cases including content creation, NFT art, music, crypto research, business automation, and code generation.
- Includes detailed workflow guidance and prompt engineering principles.
- Features a variable convention using [brackets] for easy customization.
